meta.note: Canonical per-locale translations for recurring app terms. Built and grown by glossary_build.py / glossary_sync.py; consulted by dispatch_prompts.py (translation) and audit_dispatch.py (audit). Protected nouns (Wren, iCloud) map to themselves via the '*' wildcard locale. Do not hand-edit translations — re-run the glossary pipeline.

Add.context: Imperative action verb used in button/title compounds: Add Expense, Add Budget, Add Funds, Add funds. Should compose cleanly with the noun terms so compounds stay consistent.

Add Expense.context: Compound title/button for opening the add-expense form. Recurs as both a primary button label and a nav-bar title; pin one canonical form composed from Add + Expense.

translations.th: เพิ่มรายจ่าย

Add Funds.context: Title/button for the 'add funds' mode of the add-expense screen — putting money into a budget, the opposite of logging a spend. Title-case form used for nav titles. Distinct from sentence-case 'Add funds' toggle label.

Add funds.context: Sentence-case label for the toggle that switches a transaction from an expense to an add-funds adjustment, and the default description seeded when that toggle is on. Same meaning as 'Add Funds' but sentence-case for toggle/inline use.

Allocation.context: Core domain noun: the amount of money budgeted for a period. Section header above the amount and currency fields. Keep consistent with the allocation field label.

translations.th: เงินที่จัดสรร

Amount.context: Field/section header for the monetary amount of an expense (and the allocation). Recurring field word; keep consistent across expense and allocation contexts.

Balance.context: Core domain noun: the running carry-over amount (surplus or deficit) on a budget. Appears in carry-over reset copy ('carry-over balance', 'remaining balance').

translations.th: ยอดคงเหลือ

Biweekly.context: Budget period name: a budget that resets once EVERY TWO WEEKS (fortnightly / every 14 days). CRITICAL DISAMBIGUATION: this means every two weeks — NOT 'twice a week' and NOT 'twice a month'. Beware false cognates: French 'bimensuel' actually means twice a MONTH, and a literal 'bi-weekly' calque (e.g. in some Indic/Hebrew scripts) can read as 'twice a week'. Choose the UNAMBIGUOUS local term for 'every two weeks / fortnightly'. Title-case list label, with a lowercase inline adjective form used in a sentence like 'remaining this <biweekly> period'. Part of the period-name set (Daily / Weekly / Biweekly / Monthly).

translations.th: รายสองสัปดาห์

Budget.context: Core domain noun: a spending plan with an allocation, period, and expenses. The app's central object. Singular form used in titles, name field placeholder, and compounds (Edit Budget, Delete Budget, Reset Budget). Keep identical across every screen.

Budgets.context: Plural of Budget. Navigation title of the main list screen and a Settings section header for budget-related defaults. Should match the plural rendering of the Budget term.

Cancel.context: Button that dismisses a sheet/alert/dialog WITHOUT saving (not 'cancel a subscription'). The most-reused button in the app — must read identically across every confirmation dialog, alert, and sheet.

Carry-Over.context: Core domain noun: the cumulative surplus or deficit that rolls forward from one budget period into the next. Title-case form is used for labels/headers/toggles (the Carry-Over toggle, the Settings section header, the green carry-over pill on budget cards, and the 'Reset Carry-Over…' menu item); a lowercase variant appears mid-sentence (e.g. 'the carry-over balance will reset to zero'). This is NOT a protected brand name — choose the natural accounting/budgeting term your language uses for a balance carried forward between periods (e.g. de 'Übertrag', fr 'Report', it 'Riporto', ja '繰り越し', tr 'Devir'). Pick one canonical rendering that reads well both as a standalone label and inside the example sentences. Only keep the English 'Carry-Over' if your language genuinely has no natural equivalent and consumer finance apps in your market keep the English term.

Change.context: Confirm button in the week-start day change alert: apply the new setting. Imperative confirmation, distinct from a generic 'modify'.

Currency.context: Core domain noun and field: the monetary currency of a budget. Picker navigation title and field label. Keep consistent across the picker, field, and settings.

Current Period.context: Section header for expenses in the budget's active window (biweekly or specific-dates). Daily/weekly/monthly use 'Current Day/Week/Month' variants — keep 'Period' consistent with the Period term.

translations.th: รอบปัจจุบัน

Daily.context: Budget period name (resets each day). Title-case list label; a lowercase 'daily' inline form is used inside accessibility sentences. Keep the period-name set (Daily/Weekly/Biweekly/Monthly) consistent.

Dates.context: Section header for the start/end date card shown when the Specific Dates period is selected. Plural field-group label, distinct from singular 'date'.

Deficit.context: Domain noun: a negative carry-over (overspending). Paired with 'surplus'. Lowercase label shown next to a negative carry-over amount.

Delete.context: Destructive imperative action verb: permanently remove an object. Standalone label on the expense swipe action / VoiceOver action, and the base of Delete Budget / Delete Expense. Keep the standalone word and the compounds consistent.

Delete Budget.context: Compound: the button that triggers the delete-budget confirmation AND the destructive confirm button inside it. Compose from Delete + Budget; keep identical in both places.

translations.th: ลบงบประมาณ

Delete Expense.context: Compound: the button that triggers the delete-expense confirmation AND the destructive confirm button inside it. Compose from Delete + Expense; keep identical in both places.

Description.context: The optional free-text label of an expense ('Description (optional)' section header; expense description field). Keep consistent across the section header and field.

Done.context: Button that confirms and dismisses (the Settings sheet, the date picker). Means 'finished', not 'task completed'. Keep identical across both uses.

Edit.context: Imperative action verb meaning to modify an existing object. Used in the compound Edit Budget (nav title and menu item). Should compose with noun terms.

Edit Budget.context: Compound: nav-bar title and menu item for editing an existing budget. Compose from Edit + Budget; keep identical in both places.

translations.th: แก้ไขงบประมาณ

End date.context: The date a budget ends (optional for recurring budgets). Recurring field/modifier phrase; keep consistent with 'Start date'.

translations.th: วันที่สิ้นสุด

Ended %@.context: Past-tense chip shown after a budget's end date has passed; argument is the abbreviated end date. Distinct past-tense form from 'Ends %@'.

translations.th: สิ้นสุดแล้ว %@

Ends %@.context: Schedule-summary fragment; argument is the abbreviated end date. Present tense, pairs with 'Starts %@'.

Expense.context: Core domain noun: a single logged spend that subtracts from a budget's remaining amount. Used in titles and compounds (Add Expense, Delete Expense). Keep identical across screens.

Expenses.context: Plural of Expense — multiple logged spends. Should match the plural rendering of the Expense term.

Funds.context: Core domain noun in the 'Add Funds' flow: money added to a budget's remaining balance (the opposite of an expense). Used in titles, the amount field label, and toggle. Distinct sense from a generic 'fund'.

Icon.context: The optional symbol chosen for a budget. Recurring field word: icon chip label, picker title ('Optional Icon'). Keep consistent.

Monthly.context: Budget period name (resets each month). Title-case list label with a lowercase inline form. Part of the period-name set.

Name.context: Section header above the budget name field. Recurring field word for the budget's title.

New Budget.context: Title/button for creating a budget: nav-bar title in Add mode and the Add Budget toolbar button label. Pin one canonical form.

translations.th: งบประมาณใหม่

No end date.context: Placeholder / schedule-summary fragment meaning the recurring budget has no end (recurs indefinitely). Keep consistent with the 'End date' term.

translations.th: ไม่มีวันที่สิ้นสุด

Nothing logged this period.context: Empty-state line for the current-period section when no expenses exist yet (biweekly / specific-dates). 'logged' = recorded an expense. Sibling variants swap 'period' for today/this week/this month.

Pause.context: Imperative action verb: temporarily stop an active budget (the opposite of Resume). Base of Pause Budget menu item.

Paused.context: Status of a budget that has been temporarily stopped (the opposite of active/resumed). Appears in chips and captions ('Paused since %@'). Keep consistent with the Resume/Pause verbs.

Period.context: Core domain noun: the recurring time window a budget resets over (daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly) or a one-off window for Specific Dates. Section header and used in 'Current Period' / 'Past Periods'. Keep identical everywhere.

Recents.context: Section header for the horizontal list of recent-expense suggestions in Add Expense. Short noun (recently used expenses); keep terse.

Remove.context: Button on the budget icon picker that clears the chosen icon (a non-destructive 'unset', distinct from Delete which destroys data).

Reset.context: Destructive imperative action verb meaning to clear back to a starting state. Base of Reset Budget and Reset Carry-Over (menu items and dialog confirms). Should compose with the noun terms.

Resume.context: Imperative action verb: un-pause a paused budget so the user can log expenses again. Base of Resume Budget (button and menu item).

Resume Budget.context: Compound: primary action button (when paused) and menu item to un-pause a budget. Compose from Resume + Budget; keep identical in both places.

Retry.context: Button that re-attempts a failed operation (save failure, container-creation failure). Means 'try again now'. Keep identical across both surfaces.

Save.context: Imperative action verb / button: commit the user's input and dismiss the sheet. Confirming-button label, identical on the Add/Edit Budget and Add/Edit Expense sheets.

Schedule.context: Section header / disclosure label for the start-date and end-date controls on a recurring budget. Distinct from the 'Dates' section used for Specific Dates budgets.

Send Feedback.context: Action that opens a prefilled feedback email. Appears as a Settings link and as a secondary button on error/save-failure surfaces. Keep identical everywhere.

Settings.context: The app's preferences screen: nav-bar title and toolbar button label. Keep identical across the title and the button.

Share Anonymous Usage Data.context: Analytics opt-in: accept button on the first-run consent sheet and the toggle label in Settings. Must read identically so the consent and settings surfaces agree.

Specific Dates.context: Budget period name for a one-off, non-recurring window (e.g. a trip) with fixed start/end and no carry-over. Title-case list label with a lowercase inline form. Part of the period-name set.

Surplus.context: Domain noun: a positive carry-over (money left over). Paired with 'deficit'. Lowercase label shown next to a positive carry-over amount.

Today.context: Relative day label in the expense list, and the start-date chip placeholder meaning the budget starts today. Keep both uses identical.

Weekly.context: Budget period name (resets each week). Title-case list label with a lowercase inline form. Part of the period-name set.

When.context: Section header (and matching VoiceOver label) above the expense date-and-time picker. Means 'when did this happen', not a conjunction. Keep both uses identical.

Wren.context: The product/brand name of the app. Protected noun — never translate; keep verbatim in every locale.

Yesterday.context: Relative day label used in the expense list for entries on the day before the reference day. Pairs with 'Today'.

iCloud.context: Apple's cloud sync service. Protected noun — never translate; keep the Apple-official verbatim form in every locale.
